_comment: LiteMind settings. Change values here instead of typing flags. Anything passed on the command line overrides this file.
_expert_cache_gb: 0 leaves expert residency to the OS page cache, which is fastest when there is RAM to spare. A budget copies experts into an arena of that size. Below about 2.6 GB every expert is evicted before it is reused, so use 0 or at least 4.
_sampling: temperature 0 means greedy decoding, which is reproducible but on a base model collapses into a repetition loop over a few hundred tokens. 0.7 with a repeat_penalty above 1 keeps long generations moving.
